title: SipEndpoint
description:
A SIP endpoint which is the address of your SIP infrastructure. SIP endpoints can be one of two types: static endpoints or registered endpoints.

| Endpoint | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| Static endpoints | Static endpoints are defined by a static value which can either be an IP address or a domain name. |
| Registered endpoints | Registered endpoints use a credential list to determine the endpoint. |

---

id.description: The ID of the SIP endpoint.

sipTrunkId.description: The ID of the SIP trunk to which the endpoint is assigned.

name.description: The friendly name of the SIP endpoint.

transport.description: The transport protocol of the SIP endpoint.

priority.description:
Inbound call routing priority. If two or more endpoints have the same priority, calls will be routed to them using a round-robin strategy.

Lower priority endpoints will be routed to first. Equal priority endpoints will round-robin calls between them.

enabled.description: Sets whether the SIP endpoint is enabled or not.

createTime.description: The date and time that the SIP endpoint was created.

updateTime.description: The date and time that the SIP endpoint was last modified.

isRegistered.description: This property determines whether the endpoint is static or registered. If registered, this must be set to `true`.

credentialUsername.description: The username for the credential list you want to use to register the endpoint.

address.description: The address of the SIP endpoint can be an IP address or a domain name. EST uses IP authentication and will only accept calls from the specified address or domain.

port.description: The port of the SIP endpoint.
